brief:
Ed Miliband moved Labour to a harder line on Israel, The Guardian reported, announcing sanctions against West Bank settlements deemed illegal and characterizing events in Gaza as ethnic cleansing. The announcements represent the party's most forceful language on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in recent years.

The shift came amid mounting internal pressure over Labour's Middle East policy. Miliband's move on settlements breaks with previous party positioning, which had avoided explicit calls for sanctions. His description of Gaza as ethnic cleansing goes further than Labour's prior statements on the territory, where the party had focused on humanitarian concerns and civilian casualties without using language suggesting systematic displacement of Palestinians.

title: Labour shifts stance on Israel settlements and Gaza
